oldcollege_archivist.text: Welcome to the Old College. It began as a grand seaside hotel, the owner ran out of money, and the university moved in. Education: better than rooms.
The University College of Wales opened here in 1872. Much of the money came from ordinary people, including pennies from miners and quarrymen.
That is why people call it the people's university. The Gothic building was designed by J. P. Seddon, and yes, it does look like a castle that took a degree.

oldcollege_student.text: Aber is what everyone calls the town. Aber means mouth of, so Aberystwyth is the mouth of the Ystwyth.
Half of Wales has an Aber in its name. Aberdare, Abergavenny, Aberaeron. They are all someone's river mouth.
